instrument: Interim ordinance authorizing study of data centers and imposing a moratorium (June 26, 2026), as amended Sept 14, 2026
summary: Council voted 3-2 on June 26, 2026 for a one-year moratorium on data center construction or expansion that included the pending application at 5842 Carmen Avenue East. After the developer threatened litigation citing up to $150 million in damages, council approved an ordinance removing that project from the moratorium in three readings (Aug 10, Aug 24, Sept 14); it takes effect on publication in the Pioneer Press.

source.citation: City of Inver Grove Heights, Proposed Data Center updates page (city news flash, read Sept 28, 2026)

notes: City pages give the site as 5842 Carmen Ave E and about 50,000 sq ft; the June 26 agenda item title reads 54,070 sq ft at 5890 Carmen Avenue; MPR and other reporting say 55,000 sq ft. All three recorded. Developer-stated load: 5 MW. A residents' EAW petition was reviewed by a third-party consultant; the city reports the project is exempt from an EAW. On Sept 28, 2026 the council approved the major site plan (reported; see mn-inver-grove-heights-site-plan-approval). The moratorium remains in place for any other data center until at least June 2027.
confidence_note: Read on the city's own update page; the ordinance text itself not read.
